description: Use when uploading, validating, or deploying a change set between Salesforce orgs through Setup UI. Trigger keywords: 'change set upload', 'validate change set', 'deploy inbound change set', 'change set stuck', 'missing dependency change set', 'change set component error'. NOT for release planning or rollback strategy — use admin/change-management-and-deployment. NOT for DevOps Center pipelines — use devops/devops-center-pipeline. NOT for scripted or CI/CD deploys — use devops/salesforce-cli-automation.
inputs: which components are being deployed (metadata types and names)
whether this is a validate-only or full deploy
whether Apex tests need to run and which ones
name: change-set-deployment
official_sources: Metadata API Developer Guide, Summer '26 (release 262): `deployRecentValidation()` (quick deploy from Deployment Status, 10-day window), DeployOptions `testLevel` and `rollbackOnError`, "Running Tests in a Deployment", Profile > Usage (scoped profile settings and the three always-included sections), FlowSettings `enableFlowDeployAsActiveEnabled`, Layout member naming, "Slow Deployments" - https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf

Apex Developer Guide, Summer '26: "Deploy Components to Production" (deployment connection, Create and Upload Change Sets permission, View/Add Dependencies, edition availability), "Deploy Apex Using Change Sets", Apex Scheduler (classes with active scheduled jobs), code coverage considerations (tests don't run in parallel in change set deployments) - https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_apex_developer_guide.pdf
DevOps Center guide, Summer '26: positioning as an alternative to change sets - https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/devops_center.pdf
Salesforce DX Developer Guide, Summer '26: org development model ("the deployment artifact as the inbound change set") - https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/sfdx_dev.pdf
